summary: rollup-plugins-check postinstall fetches and executes remote JavaScript with TLS verification disabled
details: The npm package rollup-plugins-check@0.0.2 declares a postinstall script (`node dist/module.js`) that, on `npm install`, performs an HTTPS GET to https://workconfig.vercel.app with `rejectUnauthorized: false` and passes the response body to `new Function('require', data)(require)`, executing the fetched code inside the installer's Node.js process with access to `require`. The remote body is opaque and controlled by whoever owns the endpoint; TLS certificate verification is explicitly disabled, so any on-path attacker can also substitute the payload. The package advertises itself as a rollup polyfill plugin and ships polyfill code copied from rollup-plugin-polyfill-node as cover, while the dropper is appended to the postinstall entry file. The name resembles the legitimate rollup-plugin-polyfill-node package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
